import type { HelpTopic } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { SurfaceController } from '../../controllers/surface-controller.js';
export declare class HelpPanel extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        topics: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        selectedTopicId: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        defaultSelectedTopicId: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        mode: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        fallbackFocusId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        narrow: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    topics: readonly HelpTopic[];
    selectedTopicId: string | null | undefined;
    defaultSelectedTopicId: string | null | undefined;
    mode: 'help' | 'tutorial';
    fallbackFocusId: string;
    private narrow;
    private state;
    private topicState;
    private media?;
    private focusPanel;
    readonly surface: SurfaceController;
    constructor();
    get committedOpen(): boolean;
    get committedTopic(): string | null;
    private resize;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    show(open: boolean): void;
    selectTopic(id: string): void;
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
